name: f-mark-monorepo
description: F-Mark — document-based interface for AI agent collaboration

scripts.build: pnpm -F @f-mark/shared build && pnpm -F @f-mark/renderer build && pnpm -F f-mark build && pnpm -F f-mark build:bundle
scripts.dev:concurrent: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; pnpm -F @f-mark/renderer dev:bundled & pnpm -F f-mark dev
